description: This Java class 'ThemeOverlayCombiner' manages theme overlays for a keyboard app, handling resource overlays such as background drawables and text colors, applying color filters, and providing access to themed resources.

classes.name: ThemeOverlayCombiner
classes.description: Main class responsible for combining theme overlays, managing resource states, and applying color filters to UI elements.

classes.name: ThemeResourcesHolderImpl
classes.description: Private static class implementing ThemeResourcesHolder interface, holding theme resource states such as text colors and backgrounds.

methods.name: setOverlayData
methods.description: Sets the overlay data and triggers resource recalculation.

methods.name: recalculateResources
methods.description: Recalculates theme resources based on current overlay data, applying color filters and updating resource states.

methods.name: overlayDrawable
methods.description: Applies a color filter to a drawable to overlay a color, or creates a new ColorDrawable if original is null.

methods.name: setThemeKeyBackground
methods.description: Sets the key background drawable and recalculates resources.

methods.name: setThemeKeyboardBackground
methods.description: Sets the keyboard background drawable and recalculates resources.

methods.name: setThemeTextColor
methods.description: Sets the key text color for the theme.

methods.name: setThemeNameTextColor
methods.description: Sets the name text color for the theme.

methods.name: setThemeHintTextColor
methods.description: Sets the hint text color for the theme.

methods.name: getThemeResources
methods.description: Returns the current theme resources, either calculated or original based on overlay validity.

methods.name: applyOnIcon
methods.description: Applies overlay primary text color as a color filter on an icon drawable.

methods.name: clearFromIcon
methods.description: Clears any color filter from an icon drawable.
